title: Explorifying
description: This project is a modpack adding structures mobs and ships also u can enable a datapack changing worldgeneration into continents
body:
![something might change the minecraft title for this](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b0904f08bbed10cbe399889df0541bf9ea9a880.png)

# CONTENT
## MOBS
**85+ New mobs** with stylistic quality above the default game.When joining a world for the first time, the player will be given the **Animal Dictionary**. This is a very basic guide and documentation of each creature added by the mod, and should provide insight into uses for each of the mobs or their drops.
## Vehicles
**Carts**:supply cart,animal cart,plow (used by clicking R)

**Ships**:Cog,Brigg,Galley,Drakkar (all with diffrent stats)
## Structures
### Villages and Pillager outposts
This addsadds **23 village variants** and **14 pillager outpost variants**, each of which is tailored to the terrain, theme, and biome of your Minecraft world.Also _deletes vanilla villages_
### Yung s better structures
1. Yung's extras
2. Yung's dungeons
3. Yung's strongholds
4. Yung's desert temples
5. Yung's jungle temples
6. Yung's nether fortress
7. Yung's ocean monuments
## Map
Press [M] at any time to bring up the world map.
Drag the map to pan, scroll to zoom, and use the bookmark buttons to create and remove map markers.

**Client-Side Features**
A physical-feeling map screen, with hand-drawn tiles representing chunks in the world.
Waypoint markers in a variety of styles and accent colors.

**Mixed-Side / Singleplayer Features**

Markers are automatically added for notable structures and active nether portals.
Structures only appear on the map after you've looked at them or stood on them in-game.
Map exploration and waypoints can be **_shared with friends via_** _/surveyor share [player]_
## Other
**_Temperature system_** coldsweat with items like a termometer and items to help u have a temperature that won t kill u like insulated armor. (this works with seasons system and your surroundings)

**_Shaders_** a pretty good lightweight shader

**_Recepture viever_** EMI it doesn t need explaining

**_Replay mod_** A mod good for recording on yt (especially good for timelapses)

A _**datapack which turns world into ocean** with continents_ i reccomend enabling it

**_And much more_**
